title: Application Launcher's search bar's input field requires a reboot in order to change fonts
line: Text typed in Kickoff's search field (and other Plasma text fields) switches to a new system font right away instead of after restarting plasmashell.
explanation: Plasma's Kirigami theme plugin (PlasmaTheme) set Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont and smallFont only when each theme object was created and never updated them on application font changes. Plasma's TextField also had no font binding, so it kept the font Qt resolved for it at creation: Qt Quick never re-resolves control fonts in plain windows when the application font changes. Items created later (the results list) got the new font, while the already-created search field kept the old one. A single application event filter now resyncs every PlasmaTheme's fonts on QEvent::ApplicationFontChange, and PlasmaComponents TextField binds its font to Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont, like qqc2-desktop-style's Label does.

commits.message:
plasmacomponents: make text fields follow system font changes

The Plasma Kirigami theme read the font only once and text fields kept
the font Qt gave them on creation, so search fields ignored font changes
until restart. Now the theme follows them and TextField binds to it.

BUG: 519438

With the fix: same steps, the typed text in the search field is serif too
